title: xgboost-creditfraud
summary: A credit card fraud detection project that preprocesses and balances imbalanced transaction data before training an XGBoost classifier, using SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic minority-class fraud samples.
evidence: data_preprocessing.py:106-153: CTGANSynthesizer(metadata,...) and TVAESynthesizer(metadata,...) instantiated and fit to generate synthetic fraud samples
